title: Opinion: Opinion | 'Blackmail' Diplomacy: Why India Can't Be A Pawn In US' War On Russia
summary_full: The new sanctions bill is both blackmail and hypocritical: blackmail because it seeks to change India's principled stand, and hypocritical because the US has provided exemptions to others, and itself.
